### Implement extensible all-operation and named plugin bindings

```yaml
id: T-787453a8-2643-48c1-8715-9626d67d5e0e
priority: 130
status: Ready
parent_pending_ids: ["P-539a810d-cdb5-4901-bbfe-a2344698b78f"]
processing_run_id: PR-9ffb62ea-745b-4d44-a772-dad8d1c35f5b
root_task_id: T-a9d7a827-fb25-4348-bcf7-867a449c58ef
related_task_id: T-a9d7a827-fb25-4348-bcf7-867a449c58ef
relation: blocker
depends_on: ["T-5efc5408-27ec-4fd0-a6d3-81c616e2e8e9", "T-6f4500f7-91e2-410d-8172-a4c4cd232fc5"]
```

Goal:
- Provide W3 extensible binding definitions, actual anchor resolution, dispatch identities and standalone composition inputs.

Touch:
- `.skill-tree/lib/plugin-bindings.js`
- `.skill-tree/lib/composer.js`
- `.skill-tree/common/references/plugin-invocation.md`
- `.skill-tree/tests/test-plugin-bindings.js`
- `.skill-tree/documents/plugin-management-contract.md`

Implementation constraints:
- A custom label requires an executable dispatch boundary; unresolved mapping remains visible.
- Explicit controller and leaf locations are not deduplicated into one call; only accidental same-event delivery deduplicates.
- Core invariants and ownership barriers remain mandatory at every anchor.
- A package identity and a binding-occurrence identity are separate entities. Repeating a package in one chain requires no duplicate package installation and never collapses another configured occurrence.

Validation:
- Strategy: test-first focused behavioral fixtures; actual agent observations remain separate from deterministic helper evidence.
```json
{
  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "extensible-bindings",
      "recipe_id": "quality-node",
      "criteria": [
        "Every owned operation accepts explicit before/during/after or registered executable named bindings, with independent binding IDs, deterministic order, conditions and parameter overrides.",
        "Natural-language/custom location resolution produces actual dispatch or a visible unresolved state; typed request/project/document/snapshot/management/controller contexts support task-free anchors without fabricated Pending/T identities, while core guards remain intact.",
        "Intentional controller/leaf placements and finite same-anchor A-to-B-to-A sequences remain distinct calls; idempotence suppresses only repeat delivery of the same binding/event/attempt, and recursive re-entry is detected from dispatch lineage rather than repeated plugin identity.",
        "Binding changes and effective parameters participate in composition/freshness identities; standalone fixtures preserve resource closure and stopped-handoff refresh behavior.",
        "Every compatible plugin, including a custom source, supports multiple independent binding occurrences at the same anchor in an explicitly configurable total order; repeated plugin IDs are valid, duplicate binding IDs are rejected, moving an occurrence preserves identity and each occurrence retains independent parameters, conditions and enabled state."
      ],
      "sources": [
        ".skill-tree/lib/plugin-bindings.js",
        ".skill-tree/lib/composer.js",
        ".skill-tree/common/references/plugin-invocation.md",
        ".skill-tree/tests/test-plugin-bindings.js",
        ".skill-tree/documents/plugin-management-contract.md",
        ".skill-tree/documents/plugin-system-contract.md",
        ".skill-tree/documents/implementation-plan.md",
        ".skill-tree/lib/plugin-parameters.js",
        ".skill-tree/templates/operations.json"
      ],
      "parameters": {
        "test_path": ".skill-tree/tests/test-plugin-bindings.js"
      },
      "assertion": "Every owned operation accepts explicit before/during/after or registered executable named bindings, with independent binding IDs, deterministic order, conditions and parameter overrides. Natural-language/custom location resolution produces actual dispatch or a visible unresolved state; typed request/project/document/snapshot/management/controller contexts support task-free anchors without fabricated Pending/T identities, while core guards remain intact. Intentional controller/leaf placements and finite same-anchor A-to-B-to-A sequences remain distinct calls; idempotence suppresses only repeat delivery of the same binding/event/attempt, and recursive re-entry is detected from dispatch lineage rather than repeated plugin identity. Binding changes and effective parameters participate in composition/freshness identities; standalone fixtures preserve resource closure and stopped-handoff refresh behavior. Every compatible plugin, including a custom source, supports multiple independent binding occurrences at the same anchor in an explicitly configurable total order; repeated plugin IDs are valid, duplicate binding IDs are rejected, moving an occurrence preserves identity and each occurrence retains independent parameters, conditions and enabled state.",
      "timing": "immediate"
    }
  ]
}
```

Acceptance:
- Every owned operation accepts explicit before/during/after or registered executable named bindings, with independent binding IDs, deterministic order, conditions and parameter overrides.
- Natural-language/custom location resolution produces actual dispatch or a visible unresolved state; typed request/project/document/snapshot/management/controller contexts support task-free anchors without fabricated Pending/T identities, while core guards remain intact.
- Intentional controller/leaf placements and finite same-anchor A-to-B-to-A sequences remain distinct calls; idempotence suppresses only repeat delivery of the same binding/event/attempt, and recursive re-entry is detected from dispatch lineage rather than repeated plugin identity.
- Binding changes and effective parameters participate in composition/freshness identities; standalone fixtures preserve resource closure and stopped-handoff refresh behavior.
- Every compatible plugin, including a custom source, supports multiple independent binding occurrences at the same anchor in an explicitly configurable total order; repeated plugin IDs are valid, duplicate binding IDs are rejected, moving an occurrence preserves identity and each occurrence retains independent parameters, conditions and enabled state.

Approved decision evidence:
- `.skill-tree/history/research/plugin-management-decisions.json`; W3 is actual owner direction, with no claim that the capability is already implemented.
